title: Will AI take editors' jobs?
summary: AI can already do really good editing, and I get graphics like these in one or two shots. The real problem is finding references: everyone goes to the same three places and finds the same stuff. So I built Sonika FrameFinder. It shows styles right away (paper cut-out, documentary, reels, carousels, Instagram stories) from Pinterest and 20 sites like it, with new references every day.
steps: Download Sonika FrameFinder from this page and open it.
Pick a style (paper cut-out, documentary, reels, carousels, Instagram stories) and browse.
New references come in every day from Pinterest and 20+ similar sites.
Paste a screenshot to find similar references.
Take your favourite reference to Claude with the prompt below to rebuild the look in one or two shots.

prompts.title: Rebuild a graphic from a reference in one shot
prompts.text:
Here's a reference for a graphic I want: [ATTACH SCREENSHOT].
My content for it: [TEXT, NUMBERS OR TOPIC THE GRAPHIC SHOWS].
Size: [1080x1920 / 1920x1080]. Tool: [AFTER EFFECTS / PREMIERE PRO / HTML / AN AI IMAGE TOOL].

1. Describe the reference style in a few lines: layout, colors, type, motion.
2. Build my version with my content in that style. If it's an animation, give me something I can run or import directly.
3. Keep it original: don't copy logos, watermarks or the exact text from the reference.
If something isn't clear, make a sensible choice and tell me what you assumed.

prompts.title: Find a fresh style for my next video
prompts.text:
My next video: [TOPIC], for [PLATFORM]. My usual style: [DESCRIBE IT].
I want to avoid looking like everyone else.

Suggest 3 visual styles that would fit (for example paper cut-out, documentary, editorial). For each: why it fits, 3 key elements, and search words I can use in FrameFinder or Pinterest to find references.

notes: You stay the creative one: references and taste are the part AI can't do for you.
API keys (optional) go only into FrameFinder's Settings, never into a chat.
